parsed.name: 稀释制冷机监测系统
parsed.description: 用于稀释制冷机运行状态监测与参数采集的软件监测系统，可用于低温实验环境中的温度与设备状态跟踪。该类系统常见于超低温物理和量子相关实验平台。
parsed.description_en: A software monitoring system for dilution refrigerator operation and parameter acquisition, used to track temperatures and equipment status in low-temperature experimental environments. Such systems are common in ultra-low-temperature physics and quantum-related platforms.
